back: An automated system that controls an individual's ability to access one or more computer system resources, such as a workstation, network, application, or database. A logical access control system requires the validation of an individual's identity through some mechanism, such as a PIN, card, biometric, or other token. It has the capability to assign different access privileges to different individuals depending on their roles and responsibilities in an organization.
